hindi: ऊर्जा संरक्षण का नियम (Oorja Sanrakshan ka Niyam)

definition.simple: Energy cannot be made from nothing, and it never just disappears. It only changes forms.
definition.academic: A fundamental principle stating that the total energy of an isolated system remains constant; it is said to be conserved over time. Energy can neither be created nor destroyed; rather, it transforms from one form to another.

examples: A falling object turning its potential energy into kinetic energy.
A lightbulb turning electrical energy into light and heat.

common_misconceptions: Energy can be 'used up' or lost entirely (when it is actually just dissipated as heat).
ai_context.tutor_hint: When they say energy is 'lost' in a machine due to friction, ask them what form it turned into (heat).
